meta_title: Campervan hire in Bari · full tank, kit and assistance included | Mistralia
meta_desc: Rent the Kentucky, a 4+1 berth campervan with pick-up in Modugno (Bari). You leave with a full tank, an equipped kitchen, off-grid gear and 24/7 roadside assistance: everything you need to hit the road.
hero_title: We'll take you wherever you want.
hero_sub: Freedom, comfort and safety: the Kentucky leaves with a full tank, a complete kit and 24/7 roadside assistance.
why_1_b: Full fuel tank, kitchen kit for 4, off-grid gear, table and chairs, 24/7 roadside assistance.

why_3_b: Two double beds always made up (overcab and rear) plus a fifth berth in the dinette. Bathroom with separate shower, air conditioning, diesel heating.
